description: Generates a smart Makefile with per-project targets.

build_tool.description: Optional build tool label recorded for integrations. The generated Makefile derives build commands from project languages; this value is not used by it.

test_command.description: Optional root-level test command. When unset, tests run per project using language-specific commands. The legacy default `go test ./...` is reserved for compatibility and still selects per-project commands; use a distinct command to override testing at the repository root.
